principle: Release IDs are immutable. Once a release ID is published, its bytes are frozen. If bytes must change, a new release ID is issued and the prior release is marked superseded (never deleted).

supplements.note: Original observation-derived NorTaxa supplement. The shard emitted the synonym alias line BEFORE its accepted-target anchor line (sort key sorted 'alias' < 'anchor' lexicographically). IdentityRegistry.load() legitimately refuses that ordering. The corrected re-emission under a NEW release ID (tax-2026.08.02-02) supersedes this ID; the recorded SHA is retained here so downstream audits can identify any artefact still bearing the a7cf966b… bytes as the superseded variant.
supplements.recovered_from_git_reason: The supplement bytes were produced under /tmp/ during W2E-A2 and never committed to Git. Only the SHA was recorded in the committed W2E-A2 evidence file (w2ea2-source-backed-anchors.json). That committed file is the historical record; no byte recovery is possible or required.

supplements.note: Replaces tax-2026.08.02-01 with anchor-first shard ordering. Identity records (21 sporely_taxon_ids and their alias binding) are unchanged in TUPLE content — only the emit order differs — but this is emitted under a NEW release ID because publishing distinct bytes under the same release ID would violate the immutability contract.

Original recovered-external supplement. Allocated 19 iNaturalist-native canonical sporely_taxon_ids. That contradicts the accepted architecture — COL XR is the canonical identity backbone; iNaturalist is a discovery/reference provider. An active iNaturalist record without an exact COL binding is NOT sufficient evidence to allocate a canonical anchor. The corrected re-emission under tax-2026.08.03-02 removes all 19 iNat anchors and reclassifies those observations as unresolved_external_identifier with reason source_record_exists_but_no_exact_canonical_connection.
supplements.recovered_from_git_reason: Same as tax-2026.08.02-01: bytes lived under /tmp/, only the SHA is committed (w2eb-external-source-recovery.json). The committed file is the historical record; no byte recovery is possible or required.

supplements.note: Only the NorTaxa 48041 -> existing sporely_taxon_id 630103 alias remains. No new sporely_taxon_id is allocated by this supplement. The 19 iNaturalist records are preserved as classification=source_record_exists_but_no_exact_canonical_connection in the policy file (with acquisition provenance and raw-response SHA-256s) but never enter the registry. The 2 deleted_or_unavailable NorTaxa 404s are similarly preserved.

invariants: no previously published release identifier refers to two byte-distinct artefacts
supersession does not delete historical evidence — every prior evidence file remains committed
corrected releases carry NEW release IDs; the depends_on graph never points at a superseded ID
the loader (database/taxonomy/reconciliation/supplement_loader.py) refuses to load an out-of-order chain, a missing dependency, a hash mismatch, a cycle, or a release-ID reuse
